content.value: A 3-Φ overhead line is being supported by three disc suspension insulators. The (15) potential across the first and second insulators are 8kV and 11kV, respectively. Calculate (i) the ratio of capacitance between pin and earth to self-capacitance of each unit, (ii) the line voltage and (iii) the string efficiency.
